evidence: Touches src/net.cpp and src/netbase.cpp with the P2P label, modifying network socket event handling and peer disconnection logic.
rationale: Prevents an unread TCP urgent pointer from causing a busy loop in the network event loop on POSIX platforms. According to commit 1fde57f1de, TCP urgent data leaves select's exception set pending on non-Windows platforms, which can spin the event loop continuously.
